messages:
lucy: quick proposal  unify public error JSON across routes. idea: keep internal headers with full detail, expose stable public shape: {"error_kind":"<enum>","error_code":"<SUBCODE>","short_message":"...","retry_after":n, "schema_version":"v1"}. badges in console map from error_kind.

ben: any change to short_message will break embedded UIs. need deprecation window + versioning.

omar: ops needs route_id for runbooks. plan: put route_id in x-rw-route-detail header and mark it internal-only. console backend can resolve request_id->route.

kate: +1. also make sure 429 subcodes are explicit so SDKs can choose backoff. propose subcodes like RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL, RATE_LIMIT_ROUTE, RATE_LIMIT_MODEL.

infra-bot: FYI adding lookup endpoint increases console reads; estimate +0.1 rps per 10k active dashboards.

devex-bot: SDK note: some languages drop unknown top-level keys. devex will add a compatibility flag to accept new schema and log parse errors.

legal: watch wording  avoid phrasing that implies SLA admissions (e.g., "service_down"). prefer neutral strings.

lucy: rollout plan: opt-in header x-rw-error-schema=compact for 2w, canary on internal tenants first. metrics: support search hits for error text, SDK parse exceptions, console link misses.

ben: i'll own support queries. omar: can you own canary runbook?

omar: yep  5% traffic, 48h, dashboards for untriaged incidents and support ticket vol. rollback if support hits > baseline*2.

lucy: i'll open RFC with exact JSON, examples, and console mockups. thanks everyone :)
